question: Should Microsoft Teams adopt this `channels.msteams.accounts` and `defaultAccount` contract, with legacy root config as the implicit default account, explicit named-account identity/port requirements, and account-scoped auth/session state?
rationale: This is a public channel configuration and upgrade contract; source review and green CI can validate the implementation shape but cannot choose the permanent Teams owner policy.

options.title: Accept Current Contract
options.body: Treat the PR's account map, default-account compatibility, per-account listener model, and scoped state/auth behavior as the supported Teams multi-account API.

options.title: Request Contract Revisions
options.body: Ask for targeted schema, listener, migration, or credential-resolution changes before merging if this is not the desired public Teams API.

options.title: Pause For Broader Design
options.body: Keep #71058 open and pause this PR if Teams multi-account support should wait for shared cross-channel account semantics or a shared-listener design.

recommendation.title: Accept Current Contract
recommendation.body: Treat the PR's account map, default-account compatibility, per-account listener model, and scoped state/auth behavior as the supported Teams multi-account API.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is Teams-specific and the PR discussion already routes the contract question to BradGroux for Microsoft/Teams guidance.
